decisions.reason: As a formwork profile line with several models that sits very close to the firm's core prefabrication-equipment business, it is still worth retaining despite limited later website evidence.

The automated concrete distributor flow control supports the firm's strategic push toward factory automation, so management would likely keep it, though its weaker visibility makes it somewhat more vulnerable than the core formwork items.
This shuttering magnet block remains a logical complementary product for integrated formwork and plant solutions, which argues for continuation even if it appears to be a smaller line.
Magnetic formwork strips are a good fit with the firm's modular and customer-specific formwork offering, and a dedicated product presentation suggests ongoing commercial relevance.
This magnetic formwork component fits the established product architecture and can be sold alongside broader system solutions, so the firm would more likely keep than withdraw it.
